decision: Retain the DOS 6.0-identical high-memory load preparation implementation.
evidence: The source matches DOS 6.0 and astro byte for byte.
COMMAND LOADHI and BIOS SYSCONF include highload.inc.
The prior LOADHI comparison covered all 2001 module bytes including HIGHLOAD.INC, with 1697 matching non-relocation bytes and 73 matching internal near branches (review 128).
The prior SYSCONF comparison covered 9192 aligned bytes and classified remaining differences as relocation fields or two short branches across a restored call (review 037).
limitations: LOADHI target module location is inferred, relocation fields and all conditional configurations are not proven, and final IO.SYS/COMMAND.COM links remain unverified.
